description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
